title: SSC CHSL: a revision routine that keeps typing practice alive
description: Build a CHSL revision cycle across maths, reasoning, English and awareness, with original checks and a separate typing or skill-test routine.
intro: CHSL preparation has two clocks: solving written questions accurately and developing the keyboard habits a later skill task may require. The 1 October schedule lists Tier 1 for 30 November–31 December 2026. Treat that as the exam window; your own date and reporting instructions come from SSC.

sections.title: Start with a four-subject diagnostic
sections.body:
Use a recent practice block to record attempts, correct answers and time in maths, reasoning, English and awareness separately. A total score can hide a section where you are slow or guessing. Pick one recurring error per subject, rather than opening a new book for every weak area.

For arithmetic, check fractions, ratios and percentages before jumping to longer applications. In English, separate vocabulary gaps from grammar errors. For awareness, distinguish a forgotten fact from a question you have never studied. The remedy changes: retrieval practice helps recall; a missing concept needs a lesson first.

sections.title: Repeat a three-day repair cycle
sections.body:
Day 1: learn or repair one small idea, then solve a short set without a timer. Day 2: attempt a mixed set that includes the repaired idea without telling yourself which question uses it. Day 3: retry the mistakes from memory and explain the first step aloud.

This is an editorial study routine, not an official timetable. Fit the block to your available hours. Start with [percentages](/quant/percentage/), [coding-decoding](/reasoning/coding-decoding/) or [error spotting](/english/error-spotting/) when the diagnostic points there. Keep one page of errors; do not turn revision into copying an entire textbook.

sections.title: Practise keyboard accuracy before chasing speed
sections.body:
Check the current notification for the post-specific typing or skill requirement, language, duration and exemption rules. LDC/JSA and DEO tasks should not be treated as interchangeable. Use a physical keyboard and a fixed seating setup for practice.

Begin with short, clean passages. Record corrected errors, omissions and repeated words alongside speed. A fast passage with many errors is not a reliable result. Add a brief keyboard block several days a week and review the same recurring key or punctuation mistakes. The [CGL typing tool](/exams/ssc-cgl/typing-test/) can support general keyboard practice; its display does not certify a CHSL skill-test pass.

sections.title: Rehearse a paper and its review
sections.body:
Take a timed paper using the current stage rules, then reserve time to review every wrong answer and lucky guess. Count how often you reread a question because you missed “not”, a unit or a condition. Those errors are often cheaper to repair than adding another hard chapter.

Before exam day, use the [CHSL dates](/exams/ssc-chsl/calendar/) and [admit-card guide](/exams/ssc-chsl/admit-card/). The CHSL 2025 final result is a separate cycle from the 2026 Tier 1 schedule. Match the year in each notice before interpreting a result as your own.

drills.prompt: A price of ₹800 rises 10%, then falls 10%. What is the final price?
drills.explanation: 800 × 1.10 × 0.90 = 792. The overall fall is 1%, because the second percentage uses a different base.

drills.prompt: A typing session is faster but has more omissions. Is it automatically an improvement?
drills.answer: No; compare accuracy and speed together.
drills.explanation: Record omissions and corrections under the same practice conditions. Use the official skill-test rules for assessment, not a self-created speed target.

checklist: Choose one repair target per subject.
Read the skill requirement for my preferred post.
Practise one short passage on a physical keyboard.

sources.label: SSC official notices and candidate portal

faqs.q: Do I know my exact shift from the date window?
faqs.a: No. The published window does not replace your individual admission certificate.

faqs.q: Is the CHSL 2025 final result the 2026 result?
faqs.a: No. Recruitment year and notice publication year are different labels; match the cycle.
